name: gizza-ai/audio-convert
summary: Convert audio between mp3, wav, ogg, flac and m4a

tool.description: Convert an audio file to mp3, wav, ogg, flac or m4a. Provide either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call). Lossy targets (mp3/ogg/m4a) take a bitrate in kbps (32-320, default 192); wav/flac are lossless and ignore it. Any input ffmpeg can decode works; embedded album art is dropped.

bitrate.description: Bitrate in kbps for lossy targets (32-320, default 192). Ignored for lossless wav/flac.

format.description: Target audio format: mp3/ogg/m4a are lossy (take a bitrate), wav/flac are lossless.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

url.description: Audio URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.
